fusions.name: Tracker's Tag
fusions.desc: Flicks a tagged thread that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 35% chance per hit to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. It consumes every affliction you have on the target and deals 18 damage plus their remaining damage, with 50% more for each affliction consumed, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Paid-Out Cord
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Reeling In
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
